notes.subject: פתים
notes.rationale: פתי i man i stap isi long givim bel long narawan — ‘ol man lapun meri long tingting’ givim piksa tasol, no rol.

notes.subject: פתים/פתי · לצים/לצון
notes.rationale: Rut i kamap tupela taim klostu — ol man olsem wok bilong ol; Tok Pisin i holim sampela tasol.

notes.subject: ol man lapun meri long tingting
notes.rationale: Hakrua: ‘Olsem long wanem taim?’ — Wisedom i askim ol man long skru.

notes.subject: ol manmeri bilong taun
notes.rationale: Tok i go long ol man Wisdom i singaut long en long v.20–21.

translation: Olsem long wanem taim, ol man lapun meri long tingting, bai yupela laikim lapun meri long tingting i go yet? Na ol man i karamapim nus bilong laik, ol i hamamas long karamapim nus bilong ol, na ol man nating ol i les long save?

tokens.gloss: ol man lapun meri long tingting
na ol man i karamapim nus bilong laik
